decisions.briefing: Stocks fell today: the NASDAQ dropped 1.7% and the S&P 500 lost 0.7%, so the market is in risk-off mode and no new candidates passed the screen. I'm holding all 7 positions and keeping the $645.88 in cash. The automatic stop-losses and profit targets will handle exits, and I'll fill the 3 open slots on the next risk-on day.

market_education.summary_en: The NASDAQ fell 1.7% while the S&P 500 fell only 0.7%, which means selling was heaviest in growth and technology stocks. When the tech-heavy index falls more than twice as far as the broad market, investors are usually pulling back from riskier, high-valuation names. No news headlines came with today's data, so no specific cause is cited here, and the move is read only from index behavior.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納斯達克指數下跌1.7%，標普500指數則僅跌0.7%，顯示沽壓主要集中於增長股及科技股。當以科技股為主的指數跌幅超過大市一倍以上，通常反映資金正撤離高估值、高風險的板塊。由於今日數據未附帶相關新聞標題，本文不引述具體消息來源，僅從指數走勢作出解讀。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off describes a period when investors grow cautious and move money out of riskier assets like growth stocks and into safer ones like bonds or cash. Tech-heavy indexes such as the NASDAQ usually fall hardest on these days. A disciplined strategy often pauses new buying during risk-off periods and waits for confidence to return instead of buying into falling prices.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨審慎，將資金由增長股等高風險資產轉投債券或現金等較安全的資產。在這類交易日，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數往往跌幅最大。紀律嚴明的投資策略通常會在避險期間暫停建立新倉，待市場信心回復後才再入市，而非在跌市中盲目接貨。
